name: Internal Wallet Service
description: Architected a concurrent-safe virtual currency wallet featuring a double-entry ledger system and zero-sum auditability. Engineered idempotent APIs with pessimistic row-level locking to eliminate deadlocks and prevent duplicate processing under parallel loads. Containerized the full stack with Docker Compose and deployed to Render.

name: Graph based data modelling and query engine for SAP O2C
description: Developed a natural language-to-SQL graph query engine for SAP Order-to-Cash data using a single-process FastAPI and Next.js container. Modeled transactional records into an in-memory NetworkX graph (773 nodes, 1148 edges) paired with a SQLite data store. Integrated Gemini 2.5 Flash using Chain-of-Thought prompting and execution guardrails to guarantee safe, read-only analytical queries.

name: Event Ingestion & User Memory Management System
description: Designed a real-time behavioral data lake processing unstructured clickstream events into a 4-layer cognitive memory model (Persistent, Episodic, Semantic, Contextual). Built a FastAPI gateway routing to MongoDB, decoupled from heavy LLM extraction tasks via a Redis-backed Celery queue. Implemented a cache-aside architecture using Redis to serve hyper-personalized user memory profiles with sub-10ms read latency.

name: Product Importer Application
description: Developed a Django application for importing large CSV files (up to 500,000 products) with real-time progress indication. Implemented Celery with Redis for asynchronous processing, webhook notifications, and bulk delete functionality. Containerized with Docker and deployed on Render with PostgreSQL database.

name: Food Delivery Microservices Platform
description: Built scalable microservices for Users, Restaurants, and Delivery using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Docker, with fully documented Swagger APIs. Implemented JWT authentication, role-based access control, and async task processing with Redis. Improved order-processing throughput 30% using async I/O and Redis-backed task execution. Deployed on Render with shared PostgreSQL database and inter-service communication via HTTP requests.

name: Identity Reconciliation Service
description: Built a FastAPI service for reconciling user identities across multiple platforms and databases. Implemented fuzzy matching algorithms using Levenshtein distance and data deduplication techniques to maintain data integrity. Features RESTful APIs for integration with existing systems and supports real-time identity resolution.

name: Hubspot Integration Module
description: Created a FastAPI-based integration module for synchronizing customer data between internal systems and HubSpot CRM. Implemented webhook listeners for real-time updates and automated data synchronization pipelines. Features secure API authentication and error handling with retry mechanisms.

name: Autopsy Labs - Autonomous Incident Post-Mortem Agent
description: Engineered an autonomous incident post-mortem generator using Python and Airia orchestration. Integrated Slack and GitHub APIs to ingest raw event timelines and commit data into a unified context window. Orchestrated a multi-agent pipeline (GPT-4o mini, GPT-5 Nano, Anthropic Sequential Thinking) with a strict Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gate to synthesize evidence and publish validated reports to Notion, reducing documentation time to under two minutes.

name: RepoWarden - Living Specification Engine
description: Architected a parallel intelligence layer to extract and validate repository intent, contracts, and architectural decisions. Utilized GitLab Duo and Anthropic Claude to analyze merge requests and generate self-updating specifications. Implemented asynchronous agent flows for pre-merge validation, auto-generating documentation, and identifying security regressions, successfully detecting and mitigating a staging environment timing attack.

name: Umbra Zero - Autonomous Security Operations Center
description: Built an edge-deployed Autonomous Security Operations Center (ASOC) utilizing DigitalOcean Gradient AI to detect and mitigate shadow API vulnerabilities. Designed a 3-agent pipeline to classify HTTP traffic, auto-generate 9-layer defense-in-depth IaC (Terraform, Kubernetes, Cloudflare), and execute adversarial validation via Python httpx. Reduced perimeter remediation latency from weeks to seconds through automated threat containment.

name: HireIQ - Multimodal AI Talent Evaluation Platform
description: Created a multimodal candidate evaluation platform leveraging AWS Bedrock and Amazon Nova 2 Lite models. Engineered a stateful FastAPI backend to synchronously ingest and analyze audio streams, text queries, and canvas whiteboard drawings. Generated transparent evaluation scorecards utilizing Extended Thinking chains to expose step-by-step AI reasoning directly to the recruiter dashboard.

name: AIHawk – Open-Source AI Resume Automation (Extended)
description: Extended and customized an open-source AI-powered job application automation system. Refactored the LLM integration layer to be provider-agnostic, enabling support for multiple LLM providers via OpenRouter-compatible APIs instead of OpenAI-only coupling. Improved configuration flexibility for model and endpoint switching without code changes, and significantly enhanced documentation to make setup, customization, and usage more developer-friendly. Focused on extensibility, developer experience, and real-world usability while working with an existing modular Python architecture.

name: AI-Powered Web Monitor
description: A full-stack monitoring system that tracks web pages for changes and generates human-readable diff summaries. Engineered a pipeline that fetches HTML content with SSRF protection, identifies structural changes via SHA256 hashing, and utilizes OpenRouter LLMs to analyze and summarize unified diffs. Features a dashboard with real-time service health tracking and a visual diff viewer.

name: Shopify AI Data Agent
description: Developed a full-stack AI agent that translates natural language queries into Shopify store insights. Built with a FastAPI backend using LangChain's ReAct pattern to orchestrate data retrieval via Shopify's REST API and complex analysis through a Python REPL. Implemented resilient data fetching with exponential backoff for rate-limit handling and a React-based chat interface for tabular data visualization.

name: Market Multiagent Intelligence
description: Developed a Streamlit-based dashboard for multi-agent market intelligence analysis using LangGraph orchestration. Integrated real-time data from NewsData.io, Firecrawl.dev, and Tavily Search APIs with Plotly visualizations. Utilized Google Qwen 2.0 and Groq LLaMA3 for fast inference with context-aware AI assistance.

name: E-commerce Virtual Assistant Chatbot
description: Developed an intelligent chatbot using Rasa framework integrated with LLMs for customer support in e-commerce. Implemented intent recognition, entity extraction, and personalized recommendations.

name: Skin Disease Classifier
description: Trained image classifier (VGG16) achieving 90% accuracy across four skin disease categories (Melanoma, Ringworm, Vitiligo, Warts). Crafted interactive Flask web interface facilitating image uploads and real-time predictions with responsive UI. Implemented preliminary treatment information pages for each disease classification.

name: Illusive.Deception (Text-to-Image Generator)
description: Created a Streamlit web application that uses Stable Diffusion v1-4 model to convert text prompts into images. Optimized for CPU performance with reduced image resolution to 256x256 and disabled safety checks. Implemented seed control for reproducible results and used torch.Generator for consistent image generation.

name: Stock Price Prediction using LSTM
description: Implemented a machine learning model using LSTM neural networks to predict stock prices. Used MinMaxScaler for feature scaling and achieved visualization of predicted vs actual stock prices.

name: Air Ticket Booking System
description: Implemented full-stack booking platform (PHP, MySQL) with real-time seat management, booking confirmation emails, and cancellation functionality. Enhanced reliability using strong validation logic and ACID-compliant MySQL operations. Features include user authentication, flight search, seat selection matrix, and ticket generation.

name: AI Image Gallery
description: Developed a responsive image gallery with search and filtering capabilities using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Implemented lazy loading for improved performance and smooth user experience.

name: Django Quiz App
description: Built a comprehensive quiz application using Django with user authentication, quiz creation, and result tracking features. Implemented RESTful APIs for mobile app integration and admin dashboard for quiz management. Features include multiple question types, time limits, and detailed analytics.
